snippet.title: Halls of Torment - The Lost Archives - Out 22nd October
snippet.description:
The latest Halls of Torment DLC, "The Lost Archives", releasing on 22nd October 2026

Get the game on:
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218750/Halls_of_Torment/
Playstation 5 - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013883
XBOX - https://www.xbox.com/games/store/halls-of-torment/9nmnms626r59

To play the base game is necessary. Halls of Torment is available in the Gamepass for XBOX and Windows.
